meta.title: Anduril NixOS Security Technical Implementation Guide

V-268078.title: NixOS must enable the built-in firewall.

V-268079.title: NixOS emergency or temporary user accounts must be provisioned with an expiration time of 72 hours or less.

V-268080.title: NixOS must enable the audit daemon.

V-268081.title: NixOS must enforce the limit of three consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during a 15-minute time period.

V-268082.title: NixOS must be configured to display the Standard Mandatory DoW Notice and Consent Banner before granting local or remote access to the system via a command line user logon.

V-268083.title: NixOS must be configured to display the Standard Mandatory DoW Notice and Consent Banner before granting local or remote access to the system via an SSH logon.

V-268084.title: NixOS must be configured to display the Standard Mandatory DoW Notice and Consent Banner before granting local or remote access to the system via a graphical user logon.

V-268085.title: NixOS must be configured to limit the number of concurrent sessions to 10 for all accounts and/or account types.

V-268086.title: NixOS must initiate a session lock after a 10-minute period of inactivity for graphical user logon.

V-268087.title: NixOS must provide the capability for users to directly initiate a session lock for all connection types.

V-268088.title: NixOS must monitor remote access methods.

V-268089.title: NixOS must implement DoW-approved encryption to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions.

V-268090.title: The NixOS audit package must be installed.

V-268091.title: NixOS must generate audit records for all usage of privileged commands.

V-268092.title: NixOS must enable auditing of processes that start prior to the audit daemon.

V-268093.title: NixOS must allocate an audit_backlog_limit of sufficient size to capture processes that start prior to the audit daemon.

V-268094.title: Successful/unsuccessful uses of the mount syscall in NixOS must generate an audit record.

V-268095.title: Successful/unsuccessful uses of the rename, unlink, rmdir, renameat, and unlinkat system calls in NixOS must generate an audit record.

V-268096.title: Successful/unsuccessful uses of the init_module, finit_module, and delete_module system calls in NixOS must generate an audit record.

V-268097.title: NixOS must generate an audit record for successful/unsuccessful modifications to the cron configuration.

V-268098.title: NixOS must generate an audit record for successful/unsuccessful uses of the truncate, ftruncate, creat, open, openat, and open_by_handle_at system calls.

V-268099.title: Successful/unsuccessful uses of the chown, fchown, fchownat, and lchown system calls in NixOS must generate an audit record.

V-268100.title: Successful/unsuccessful uses of the chmod, fchmod, and fchmodat system calls in NixOS must generate an audit record.

V-268101.title: NixOS must notify the system administrator (SA) and information system security officer (ISSO) (at a minimum) when allocated audit record storage volume reaches 75 percent utilization.

V-268102.title: NixOS must notify the system administrator (SA) and information system security officer (ISSO) (at a minimum) when allocated audit record storage volume reaches 90 percent utilization.

V-268103.title: NixOS must take action when allocated audit record storage volume reaches 75 percent of the repository maximum audit record storage capacity.

V-268104.title: NixOS must take action when allocated audit record storage volume reaches 90 percent of the repository maximum audit record storage capacity.

V-268105.title: The NixOS audit system must take appropriate action when the audit storage volume is full.

V-268106.title: The NixOS audit system must take appropriate action when an audit processing failure occurs.

V-268107.title: NixOS must have the packages required for offloading audit logs installed and running.

V-268108.title: The NixOS audit records must be off-loaded onto a different system or storage media from the system being audited.

V-268109.title: NixOS must authenticate the remote logging server for off-loading audit logs.

V-268110.title: NixOS audit daemon must generate logs that are group-owned by root.

V-268111.title: NixOS audit directory and logs must be owned by root to prevent unauthorized read access.

V-268112.title: NixOS audit directory and logs must be group-owned by root to prevent unauthorized read access.

V-268113.title: NixOS audit log directory must have a mode of 0700 or less permissive.

V-268114.title: NixOS audit logs must have a mode of 0600 or less permissive.

V-268115.title: NixOS journald directory and logs must be owned by root to prevent unauthorized read access.

V-268116.title: NixOS journald directory and logs must be group-owned by systemd-journald to prevent unauthorized read access.

V-268117.title: NixOS systemd-journald directory must have a mode of 2755 or less permissive.

V-268118.title: NixOS systemd-journald logs must have a mode of 0640 or less permissive.

V-268119.title: NixOS audit system must protect logon UIDs from unauthorized change.

V-268120.title: NixOS audit configuration files must have a mode of 444 or less permissive.

V-268121.title: NixOS system configuration file directories must have a mode of "0755" or less permissive.

V-268122.title: NixOS system configuration files and directories must be owned by root.

V-268123.title: NixOS system configuration files and directories must be group-owned by root.

V-268124.title: NixOS, for PKI-based authentication, must validate certificates by constructing a certification path (which includes status information) to an accepted trust anchor.

V-268125.title: NixOS must enforce authorized access to the corresponding private key for PKI-based authentication.

V-268126.title: NixOS must enforce password complexity by requiring that at least one uppercase character be used.

V-268127.title: NixOS must enforce password complexity by requiring that at least one lowercase character be used.

V-268128.title: NixOS must enforce password complexity by requiring that at least one numeric character be used.

V-268129.title: NixOS must require the change of at least 50 percent of the total number of characters when passwords are changed.

V-268130.title: NixOS must store only encrypted representations of passwords.

V-268131.title: NixOS must not have the telnet package installed.

V-268132.title: NixOS must enforce 24 hours/one day as the minimum password lifetime.

V-268133.title: NixOS must enforce a 180-day maximum password lifetime restriction.

V-268134.title: NixOS must enforce a minimum 15-character password length.

V-268135.title: NixOS must uniquely identify and must authenticate organizational users (or processes acting on behalf of organizational users).

V-268136.title: NixOS must use multifactor authentication for network access to privileged accounts.

V-268137.title: NixOS must not allow direct login to the root account via SSH.

V-268138.title: NixOS must not allow direct login to the root account.

V-268140.title: A sticky bit must be set on all NixOS public directories to prevent unauthorized and unintended information transferred via shared system resources.

V-268141.title: NixOS must manage excess capacity, bandwidth, or other redundancy to limit the effects of information flooding types of denial-of-service (DoS) attacks.

V-268142.title: NixOS must terminate all SSH connections after 10 minutes of becoming unresponsive.

V-268143.title: NixOS must terminate all SSH connections after becoming unresponsive.

V-268144.title: NixOS must protect the confidentiality and integrity of all information at rest.

V-268145.title: NixOS must enforce password complexity by requiring that at least one special character be used.

V-268146.title: NixOS must protect wireless access to and from the system using encryption.

V-268147.title: NixOS must protect wireless access to the system using authentication of users and/or devices.

V-268148.title: NixOS must prevent all software from executing at higher privilege levels than users executing the software.

V-268149.title: NixOS must, for networked systems, compare internal information system clocks at least every 24 hours with a server which is synchronized to one of the redundant United States Naval Observatory (USNO) time servers, or a time server designated for the appropriate DoW network (NIPRNet/SIPRNet), and/or the Global Positioning System (GPS).

V-268150.title: NixOS must synchronize internal information system clocks to the authoritative time source when the time difference is greater than one second.

V-268151.title: NixOS must have time synchronization enabled.

V-268152.title: NixOS must prohibit user installation of system software without explicit privileged status.

V-268153.title: NixOS must notify designated personnel if baseline configurations are changed in an unauthorized manner.

V-268154.title: NixOS must prevent the installation of patches, service packs, device drivers, or operating system components without verification they have been digitally signed using a certificate that is recognized and approved by the organization.

V-268155.title: NixOS must require users to reauthenticate for privilege escalation.

V-268156.title: NixOS must require users to reauthenticate when changing roles.

V-268157.title: NixOS must implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the integrity of nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic communications, when used for nonlocal maintenance sessions.

V-268158.title: NixOS must protect against or limit the effects of denial-of-service (DoS) attacks by ensuring the operating system is implementing rate-limiting measures on impacted network interfaces.

V-268159.title: NixOS must protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.

V-268160.title: NixOS must implement nonexecutable data to protect its memory from unauthorized code execution.

V-268161.title: NixOS must implement address space layout randomization to protect its memory from unauthorized code execution.

V-268163.title: NixOS must generate audit records when successful/unsuccessful attempts to modify security objects occur.

V-268164.title: NixOS must generate audit records when successful/unsuccessful attempts to delete privileges occur.

V-268165.title: NixOS must generate audit records when successful/unsuccessful attempts to delete security objects occur.

V-268166.title: NixOS must generate audit records when concurrent logons to the same account occur from different sources.

V-268167.title: NixOS must generate audit records for all account creations, modifications, disabling, and termination events.

V-268168.title: NixOS must implement NIST FIPS-validated cryptography for the following: to provision digital signatures, to generate cryptographic hashes, and to protect unclassified information requiring confidentiality and cryptographic protection in accordance with applicable federal laws, Executive Orders, directives, policies, regulations, and standards.

V-268169.title: NixOS must prevent the use of dictionary words for passwords.

V-268170.title: NixOS must enable the use of pwquality.

V-268171.title: NixOS must enforce a delay of at least four seconds between logon prompts following a failed logon attempt.

V-268172.title: NixOS must not allow an unattended or automatic logon to the system via the console.

V-268173.title: NixOS must be configured to use AppArmor.

V-268174.title: NixOS must disable account identifiers (individuals, groups, roles, and devices) after 35 days of inactivity.

V-268175.title: NixOS must employ approved cryptographic hashing algorithms for all stored passwords.

V-268176.title: NixOS must employ strong authenticators in the establishment of nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic sessions.

V-268177.title: NixOS must implement multifactor authentication for remote access to privileged accounts in such a way that one of the factors is provided by a device separate from the system gaining access.

V-268178.title: NixOS must prohibit the use of cached authenticators after one day.

V-268179.title: For PKI-based authentication, NixOS must implement a local cache of revocation data to support path discovery and validation in case of the inability to access revocation information via the network.

V-268180.title: NixOS must run a supported release of the operating system.

V-268181.title: NixOS must define default permissions for all authenticated users in such a way that the user can only read and modify their own files.
